records.title: L&T wins significant construction orders for residential and commercial developments
records.summary: Several completed construction order awards for residential projects in Mumbai and Bengaluru and commercial development in Hyderabad. Company labels the orders Significant (₹1,000–2,500 crore); exact amount and customer are not disclosed.
records.source: Original company announcement filed with NSE and BSE
records.notes: The ₹1,000–2,500 Cr bracket is L&T's published classification, NOT an exact contract value, and should not be summed as if all individual orders are separately sized.

records.title: KEC International wins transmission orders from PGCIL
records.summary: KEC International's NSE corporate disclosure says it won substantial new orders worth ₹2,872 crore from Power Grid Corporation of India Limited (PGCIL).
records.customer: Power Grid Corporation of India Limited
records.notes: Amount and counterparty reported in the official NSE corporate-announcements listing dated October 24, 2026. The original attached company filing should be reviewed for full scope and terms.
